justification: 3a computation-chain ledger restructure. Split the single ConstraintStep list into two labelled phases so the on-screen chain stops pretending to be one sum that doesn't add up: phase 'lep' presents FSR vs height as ALTERNATIVES (the smaller caps the maximum), phase 'dcp' is a reconciling erosion ledger (output == input - reduction). Display-only / presentation change — verified no headline number drift across 5 live addresses.

pre_impl.existing_data: compute_constraint_arithmetic builds ConstraintStep[] mixing LEP-envelope establishment with DCP footprint+GFA erosion. Confirmed result.lep_max_gfa_from_height_m2 (was the eroded gfa_from_height) is display-only — envelope uses clean_height_gfa, current_gfa uses gfa_from_height, binding uses clean_height_gfa — so realigning the displayed height GFA to clean does not change any computed headline.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The flat step table implied a single subtraction chain (e.g. 397-278-121) that never reconciled, because LEP caps (alternatives) and DCP erosions (sequential) were rendered together.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new module. Added ConstraintStep.phase; tagged steps lep/dcp; set the LEP height step + lep_max_gfa_from_height_m2 to the clean full-lot envelope; populated input_gfa_m2 on the GFA-erosion steps so reduction = input - output by construction; the frontend card groups steps into two labelled tables.
pre_impl.external_source_error: No data fetching. Pure computation/presentation; the engine already handles missing controls (gaps list).
pre_impl.frontend_type: TypeScript: ConstraintStep gains optional phase; the card filters by phase (phase!=='dcp' -> LEP group, ==='dcp' -> DCP group) so unphased/legacy steps degrade into the LEP group rather than vanish. tsc --noEmit passes.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: a single chain that didn't sum and a height-GFA that looked smaller than the envelope. After: 'Maximum envelope (LEP)' shows the FSR and height caps with the binding one and min; 'After council DCP (indicative)' shows a reconciling erosion ending at the dcp_adjusted figure, explicitly labelled as separate, not subtracted from the LEP maximum.

functions.name: compute_constraint_arithmetic
functions.input: lot area, dev_type, LEP height/FSR strings, lot dimensions, DCP controls, SEPP standards/overrides, shadow result
functions.output: ConstraintArithmeticResult whose steps are now phase-tagged; LEP steps are alternatives, DCP GFA steps reconcile (output == input - reduction)
functions.if_none: missing controls still produce the LEP envelope (headline) and an honest gaps list; the DCP figure is only surfaced when lot geometry is reliable

values: N/A - no hardcoded regulatory values. FSR/height/setback/parking values come from the LEP/DCP/SEPP inputs; the change only re-labels and re-groups the derived steps.
queries: N/A - no database or API query.

break_it.scenario: The restructure silently changes a headline GFA or dwelling count
break_it.what_happens: the demo numbers would drift from the verified values
break_it.repro: captured _ca_before.json for 5 live addresses, re-ran after the change, diffed realistic_gfa/lep_envelope/dcp_adjusted/all dwellings
break_it.how: HEADLINE UNCHANGED: True for all 5; only lep_max_gfa_from_height_m2 (display) changed from eroded to clean, as intended

break_it.scenario: A DCP GFA step's reduction and output disagree (the 'broken sum')
break_it.what_happens: the chain would look wrong again
break_it.repro: test_constraint_phased_ledger.test_dcp_gfa_steps_reconcile asserts output == round(input - reduction, 1) for every GFA step
break_it.how: reduction_m2 is set to input - output by construction (after the floor-at-0 clamp), so it always reconciles

break_it.scenario: An LEP step is mistaken for part of a subtraction chain
break_it.what_happens: the two phases would be summed again
break_it.repro: test_lep_steps_are_alternatives_not_a_chain asserts LEP steps carry no input_gfa_m2; the card renders LEP as a cap list, not input/change/output
break_it.how: LEP steps show only their cap and the min; the DCP table is visually separate with an 'not subtracted from it' note

break_it.scenario: Legacy/unphased steps from an older payload
break_it.what_happens: steps could vanish if filtered only by phase==='lep'
break_it.repro: the card uses phase!=='dcp' for the LEP group, so a null phase still renders
break_it.how: unphased steps fall into the LEP group rather than disappearing
